blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 153 to 167 of the Indian Constitution deal with the State Executive.
The State Executive consists of the Governor, the Chief Minister, and the Council of Ministers.
Articles 153–167 lay out the constitutional structure and powers regarding state governance.
